name: Zipz Bear Lake Muenster Burger (Hold Jalapeño Jelly)
whyItWorks: Hand-formed beef patty topped with melted Muenster cheese (naturally very low in lactose) on a soft bun—safe once you hold the signature jalapeño jelly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Bear Lake Muenster Burger with meat, Muenster cheese, and bun only—strictly hold the spicy jalapeño jelly and raw onions.
watchOuts: Must hold the jalapeño jelly (capsaicin and seeds)
